name: Little Tree | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Green Apple
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Live Resin

Our Green Apple Live Resin Gummies are crafted for a refreshing lift. With 20MG of live resin in every bite, this gummy delivers a true-to-plant experience with crisp, tart flavor and smooth, lasting effects.

With a satisfying texture and vibrant finish, it’s the ideal companion for active days or mental resets.

Whether you're on a midday hike or journaling under the trees—this gummy brings clarity.
